shellCommands.command: ls -a && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && ls -R .agents | head -50

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; find src -type f | xargs ls -la; cat src/*.tsx; cat index.html; rg -n -i "theme" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -40

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeValue useThemeType RadioButton Switch 2>&1 | head -60; rg -n -i "useTheme|useThemeValue|useThemeType|DEFAULT_THEME|systemTheme|\bv8\b|Provider" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -40
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeValue RadioButton 2>&1 | head -60; sed -n 60,90p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -n -i "theme" README.md | head -20; ls build/esm/components/theme; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>&1 | head -120; ls build/esm/components/RadioButton 2>&1| head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat theme/useThemeContext.d.ts theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts theme/useThemeType.d.ts theme/useThemeValue.d.ts theme/index.d.ts; ls | grep -i -E "radio|switch|segmented"; cat ThemeProvider/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "Text\b" Text/Text.d.ts | head -3; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
